title: Admission.
bodyText:
part VI. MEMBERS AND MEMBERSHIPS

(a) The articles or bylaws may establish criteria or procedures for the admission of members.

(b) No person shall be admitted as a member without the person's consent.
bodyHtml:
part VI.  MEMBERS AND MEMBERSHIPS

 

     [§414D-81]  Admission.  (a)  The articles or bylaws may establish criteria or procedures for the admission of members.

     (b)  No person shall be admitted as a member without the person's consent. [L 2001, c 105, pt of §1]
